verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਧਾਵਤ ਬਰਜਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਚਿਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan saran gur dhaavat baraj raakhai nihachal chit sukh sahaj nivaas hai ||

en.bdb: The unique servant of the True Guru keeps the wandering mind under control by taking the refuge of the Guru and practicing meditation on the consecrated words of the Guru. His mind becomes stable and he rests in the comfort of his self (soul).

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ਅਰੁ ਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਿਟੀ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jeevan kee aasaa ar maran kee chi(n)taa miTee jeevan mukat gurmat ko pragaas hai ||

en.bdb: He loses the desire for a long life and fear of death disappears. He becomes free of all worldly bonds while still alive. The teachings and wisdom of the Guru takes over his mind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਹੋਨਹਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਈ ਭਲੋ ਮਾਨੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਰਬਾਤਮ ਕੈ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aapaa khoi honahaar hoi soiee bhalo maanai sevaa sarabaatam kai dhaasan ko dhaas hai ||

en.bdb: He discards and destroys his self-assertion and accepts the dispensation of the Almighty as fair and just. He serves all living beings and thus becomes a slave of the slaves.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਸਬਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬ ਮਈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੨੮੧॥
verses.translit_en: sree gur dharas sabadh braham giaan dhiaan pooran sarab miee braham bisavaiaas hai ||281||

en.bdb: By practicing the words of Guru, he acquires the divine knowledge and contemplation. And thus he is assured that the perfect God Lord pervades in all. (281)
